description: The study adapts Chaichumpa and Temdee's (2018) objective distance model to compute learners' CT competency in real time during iThinkSmart gameplay.
title: Objective distance (OD) model for real-time competency measurement

description: The article argues that existing AIED techniques such as knowledge tracing presuppose a decomposition of skills into knowledge components (as in ACT-R and the Cognitive Tutor), which is difficult in workplace-based settings with multi-source data.
title: Observation-based data collection as an alternative to knowledge-component tracking in workplace settings

title: Observer-based process mining method for process-oriented feedback in procedural medical training
